key_insight: Vibe-FDTR combines an LLM agent workflow with a configuration-driven FDTR code base so natural-language requests can be converted into reproducible thermal-analysis steps.
engineering_relevance: This improves the reliability, speed, and accessibility of micro/nanoscale thermal metrology for materials characterization and experimental decision-making.
method: Agent skills translate user intent into ordered FDTR analysis actions.
A domain code package enforces physical and parametric consistency during execution.
An optional expert mode performs sensitivity and uncertainty analysis for planning and underspecified tasks.
evidence_signal: On a benchmark with synthetic single-step and real-data multi-step FDTR tasks, the system achieved 100% and 98.9% success, respectively, while outperforming ablations in both accuracy and efficiency.
watch_item: Performance likely depends on correct task specification and robust integration between the LLM agent and the FDTR package, so edge cases and hidden assumptions still need careful validation.
paper_title: Vibe-FDTR: An agent-oriented framework for reproducible frequency-domain thermoreflectance data analysis
